# Steward demo: valid metadata

This synthetic dataset demonstrates metadata checks and the separate read-only resource counter.

- `records.csv` and `records.jsonl` each contain two records; `records.json` contains three items. Steward can count all three formats.
- `overview.pdf` is a small synthetic PDF. Steward does not count records in PDF files.
- `buckets.csv` has arbitrary headers (`group`, `mean_score`) and non-negative floating-point values.

The CSV, JSON and JSONL counts are stored in `datapackage.json`; the PDF has no count.
